en: A colorized postcard view of a historic European town square surrounded by red‑roofed buildings. The square is busy with people, horse‑drawn carts, trees, market stalls and parasols. On the right rises a large clock tower overlooking the rooftops, with hills visible in the distant background. The caption at the top names the city in three languages and identifies the square. The reverse side is a standard divided-back layout labeled as a Romanian postcard, with printer information at the bottom.
